predictions.rationale: Primary class representing the UML State Diagram within ArgoUML; directly implements the diagram type described (tracks object states as events occur).
Provides the graph model (nodes, edges, semantics) for state diagrams, a core part of the feature’s underlying data representation.
Responsible for rendering state diagram elements (states, transitions) onto the canvas, directly supporting the visual aspect of the feature.
Figure class that draws individual State elements; essential for depicting the various states of an object in the diagram.
Figure class that renders Transition edges between states, representing the events that cause state changes.
Superclass for state-related figures (states, pseudostates); provides shared behavior and layout for state diagram nodes.
Model-level helper offering utility operations for UML state machines; supports the semantic manipulation of states and transitions.
Alternative/updated implementation of UML State Diagram in the newer ‘state2’ module, indicating direct support for the feature.
Factory responsible for creating instances of state diagrams in the ‘state2’ module, crucial for diagram instantiation.
Base figure class for vertices (states, pseudostates) in the new state diagram implementation; fundamental to diagram rendering.
